src = open("entry.py").read()

# 2) store() gains an undo log parameter and records chunk replacements
old_store = '''    def store(self, off, data, keep_first):
        """Store ``data`` at ``off``; return "PROTOCOL_VIOLATION" on conflict."""
        chunks = self.chunks
        csize = CSIZE
        n = len(data)
        pos = 0
        while pos < n:
            a = off + pos
            base = a - (a % csize)
            idx = a - base
            take = n - pos
            room = csize - idx
            if take > room:
                take = room
            ch = chunks.get(base)
            if ch is None:
                buf = bytearray(2 * csize)
                buf[idx:idx + take] = data[pos:pos + take]
                buf[csize + idx:csize + idx + take] = b"\\x01" * take
                chunks[base] = bytes(buf)
            else:
                ones = ch[csize + idx:csize + idx + take].count(1)
                if ones == 0:
                    buf = bytearray(ch)
                    buf[idx:idx + take] = data[pos:pos + take]
                    buf[csize + idx:csize + idx + take] = b"\\x01" * take
                    chunks[base] = bytes(buf)
                elif ones == take:
                    if not keep_first and ch[idx:idx + take] != data[pos:pos + take]:
                        return "PROTOCOL_VIOLATION"
                else:
                    buf = bytearray(ch)
                    i = idx
                    j = pos
                    end = idx + take
                    while i < end:
                        if buf[csize + i]:
                            if not keep_first and buf[i] != data[j]:
                                return "PROTOCOL_VIOLATION"
                        else:
                            buf[i] = data[j]
                            buf[csize + i] = 1
                        i += 1
                        j += 1
                    chunks[base] = bytes(buf)
            pos += take
        return None'''
new_store = '''    def store(self, off, data, keep_first, undo):
        """Store ``data`` at ``off``; return "PROTOCOL_VIOLATION" on conflict.

        Every chunk replacement is journalled into ``undo`` as
        (base, previous chunk or None) so that a failed packet can be rolled
        back without copying whole chunk dictionaries.
        """
        chunks = self.chunks
        csize = CSIZE
        n = len(data)
        pos = 0
        while pos < n:
            a = off + pos
            base = a - (a % csize)
            idx = a - base
            take = n - pos
            room = csize - idx
            if take > room:
                take = room
            ch = chunks.get(base)
            if ch is None:
                buf = bytearray(2 * csize)
                buf[idx:idx + take] = data[pos:pos + take]
                buf[csize + idx:csize + idx + take] = b"\\x01" * take
                chunks[base] = bytes(buf)
                undo.append((self, base, None))
            else:
                ones = ch[csize + idx:csize + idx + take].count(1)
                if ones == 0:
                    buf = bytearray(ch)
                    buf[idx:idx + take] = data[pos:pos + take]
                    buf[csize + idx:csize + idx + take] = b"\\x01" * take
                    chunks[base] = bytes(buf)
                    undo.append((self, base, ch))
                elif ones == take:
                    if not keep_first and ch[idx:idx + take] != data[pos:pos + take]:
                        return "PROTOCOL_VIOLATION"
                else:
                    buf = bytearray(ch)
                    i = idx
                    j = pos
                    end = idx + take
                    while i < end:
                        if buf[csize + i]:
                            if not keep_first and buf[i] != data[j]:
                                return "PROTOCOL_VIOLATION"
                        else:
                            buf[i] = data[j]
                            buf[csize + i] = 1
                        i += 1
                        j += 1
                    chunks[base] = bytes(buf)
                    undo.append((self, base, ch))
            pos += take
        return None'''
assert old_store in src
src = src.replace(old_store, new_store)

        """Extend the contiguous stored prefix from offset 0."""
        c = self.contig
        chunks = self.chunks
        csize = CSIZE
        while True:
            base = c - (c % csize)
            ch = chunks.get(base)
            if ch is None:

            if j < 0:
                c = base + csize
                continue
            c = base + (j - csize)

        self.contig = c'''
new_adv = '''    def advance(self, undo):
        """Extend the contiguous stored prefix from offset 0."""
        c = self.contig
        chunks = self.chunks
        csize = CSIZE
        while True:
            base = c - (c % csize)
            ch = chunks.get(base)
            if ch is None:
                break
            j = ch.find(0, csize + (c - base), 2 * csize)
            if j < 0:
                c = base + csize
                continue
            c = base + (j - csize)
            break
        if c != self.contig:
            undo.append((self, "contig", self.contig))
            self.contig = c'''
assert old_adv in src
src = src.replace(old_adv, new_adv)
